text: During patrol at 02:15 I found the rear fence cut and the loading bay gate forced open. Two pallets of stock appear stolen. Intruder not on site now. CCTV camera 7 may have footage.

A contractor plugged an unknown USB drive into the management workstation in the data hall. The machine then showed a ransomware note on screen. We disconnected the network cable. No other machines affected so far.

A drum of degreaser tipped over in aisle 3 and there is a strong chemical smell and visible spill spreading. One colleague says she feels dizzy and is sitting outside. Fumes are noticeable near the mezzanine.
An employee slipped on an icy walkway near the staff entrance this morning and injured his wrist. First aider treated him and he has gone to hospital for an X-ray. Walkway has not been gritted.
A person without a badge tailgated an engineer through the secure turnstile at 09:40. They were challenged in the corridor and left the building. Nothing appears taken.

Several staff received an email claiming to be from IT asking them to confirm their password on an external login page. At least one person entered credentials before we warned everyone. Contact was reported to phishing@ourcorp.example and 0191 496 0000.
Near miss: a forklift reversed out of bay 2 while a pedestrian was crossing without looking. No contact was made and nobody was hurt, but this is the third near miss at that corner this month.
The main conveyor motor is overheating and cutting out every hour. Production is running at half rate. The motor casing is too hot to touch and maintenance suspect a failing bearing.
